title: Personal Income and Outlays, August 2026
discussion_signal: The post links the BEA release and separates demand-side pressure from supply-side pressure, asking whether jobs and consumption or energy and agricultural prices are driving inflation. It adds a public interpretation of the same aggregate data while leaving household-level purchasing power and causal attribution unresolved.
linked_research_question: When spending remains strong, how much of the pressure comes from household demand versus supply and price pass-through?
limits: The post offers an interpretation rather than a causal decomposition
Aggregate PCE cannot identify which households absorb price pressure
The post does not establish future rate decisions or consumer welfare
